value.rationale: The positivity of consistent-mass nodal heat propagators is a natural discretization-quality invariant. A universal all-mesh reentrant sign of the same coefficient contradicts monotone intuition that a locally positive influence stays positive while diffusion proceeds, and the theorem gives a fixed rational-time witness, least dimension, and exact minimal-size positivity horizon. The all-size portion is proved using a finite rational certificate together with an analytic tail estimate; the six-node invariant is naturally motivated as the first dimension where this new phenomenon occurs, rather than an arbitrary matrix sample.
